_comment: Ported from JOBS in Parlour v23.dc.html (line ~1230). Keyed by the job's role string, which sitters.json/boss.json reference via 'role'.

THE LAUNDRESS.t: She works while she talks. You draw one more card every reading.

THE POSTMAN.t: He brings you things. One more energy every reading.

SHE WILL NOT MARRY HIM.t: It is Saturday either way. One reading fewer than usual.

THE GRAVEDIGGER.t: He is in no hurry at all. One reading more than usual.

THE ELECTRICIAN.t: They want the fault found first. Whatever opens the sentence restores +3.

THE SCHOOLTEACHER.t: She marks your work. Saying the same sign twice in a row restores +3.

THE BUTCHER.t: He pays by weight. Every reading pays 3 centimes.

THE PRIEST.t: He has heard worse in confidence. Your first reading deals two more cards.

THE CLOCKMAKER.t: Four minutes fast. Whatever closes the sentence restores +3.

HE PAID IN ADVANCE, WHICH IS ITS OWN KIN.t: He paid in advance. One card fewer in every hand.
